audience: Potential clients and the owner judging what this code-driven studio can produce
promise: One studio covers kinetic type, physics, camera and depth, light, music sync, every format and real product data
cta: Bring your next film to the studio: «فيلمك الجاي يبدأ هنا»
direction: Swiss-modern abilities résumé: ink/paper/vermilion/cobalt, Montserrat + El Messiri, a running 01/08 index, shape-continuity hand-offs, one camera whip at the energy peak, 128 BPM original score

assets.rights: Studio's own test-fixture app, captured by examples/app-film-study/capture.mjs; no third-party material

sound.note: Synthesised in showreel/score.mjs with lib/audio.mjs + lib/sfx.mjs; no samples, no licence needed

creative.viewer: a client scrolling past studio reels who decides in seconds whether this studio is worth a brief
creative.problem: most AI-made reels look like one template with effects pasted on
creative.promise: every craft of a motion studio, directed, in fifteen seconds
creative.evidence: each bar is a working Generation 2 capability: spring physics, depth camera, WebGL light, a measured music map, aspect recomposition, verified app read-back
creative.emotion: confident momentum: tension in the first half, release on the drop, calm authority at the end
creative.motif: a vermilion dot that keeps changing shape and carries each section into the next
creative.light: flat graphic light except one lit 2.5D set and one shader-lit dark section
creative.camera: one operator: macro pull-back flowing through keys, foreground pass with rack focus, one whip
creative.motion: springs with honest overshoot, ripple staggers, inertia falls; one dominant action per bar
creative.sound: original 128 BPM electronic bed; accents only on frame 1, the whip, the drop, the UI confirm and the end card
creative.pacing: one ability per bar; hook bar, building bars 2–4, drop at bar 5, settle into a held end card
creative.payoff: the dot that opened the reel closes it inside a frame with the invitation

shots.purpose: hook: the thesis in kinetic Arabic type, frame one already designed
springs, ripple stagger, inertia: motion with weight
one operator in a layered set: pull-back, foreground pass, rack focus
shader light and analytic particles serving one ring
picture driven by the measured music map of this score
a real app value, read back and verified, presented by the camera
payoff and invitation, held still to read
